title: ScopeBench: Evaluating Cultural Norm Scope Awareness in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.18600v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety evaluation in large language models treats harm as culturally invariant, yet a model cannot correctly apply a safety norm without knowing whose norms bind. We introduce ScopeBench, a benchmark that treats cultural scope as a first-class safety dimension. It comprises 3,323 norms spanning 49 countries across nine cultural clusters, each annotated as Universal or Specific. We define three scope error types identically across four evaluation tasks: Scope Inflation, Scope Deflation, and Scope Displacement. Evaluating 21 frontier LLMs across seven model families, we surface three structural failures. First, the dominant error type inverts with prompt format: Scope Deflation reaches 70% in single-answer classification, while Scope Inflation reaches 33% when each candidate culture is judged independently. Second, scope-classification accuracy is empirically decoupled from behavioral safety: the six classifiers achieving at least 97% Task

translated_title: ScopeBench：评估大语言模型对文化规范适用范围的感知能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18600v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大语言模型的安全评估通常将危害视为文化不变，然而，如果模型不知道一项安全规范约束的是哪些文化群体，它就无法正确应用该规范。我们提出了ScopeBench，这是一个将文化范围视为一等安全维度的基准。该基准包含3,323条规范，涵盖九个文化集群中的49个国家，每条规范被标注为“普遍适用”或“特定适用”。我们在四个评估任务中以统一方式定义了三种范围错误类型：范围膨胀、范围缩减和范围偏移。通过对来自七个模型家族的21个前沿大语言模型进行评估，我们发现了三种结构性失败。首先，主导错误类型会随提示格式而反转：在单答案分类中，范围缩减错误达到70%，而在独立判断每个候选文化时，范围膨胀错误达到33%。其次，范围分类准确率与行为安全性在实证上是脱钩的：达到至少97%任务准确率的六个分类器……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出ScopeBench基准，将文化规范适用范围作为大语言模型安全评估的一等维度，通过3,323条覆盖49个国家的规范测试，揭示了模型范围错误随提示格式反转、以及范围分类准确率与实际行为安全性脱钩等结构性失败。
en_tdlr: ScopeBench introduces a benchmark that treats cultural scope as a first-class safety dimension, using 3,323 norms across 49 countries to reveal structural failures in LLMs where dominant scope error types invert with prompt format and scope-classification accuracy is empirically decoupled from behavioral safety.
